question: What did Lyft find when economists tested fares set just under a whole dollar on its riders?
answer: That the last cent matters enormously. Lyft had not used 99-cent endings; across 600 million sessions and a test on 21 million riders, about half of the fall in demand as fares rise came at the dollar marks, as from $13.99 to $14.00. If that held, it was worth roughly $160 million a year.
move: Never assume a clever firm has already tried the obvious trick.
source: List et al., Review of Economic Studies, 2023
